# Psalm 54 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 54:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** O-God, by-Your-name save-me, and-by-Your-might vindicate-me.
- **LOGOS:** O God, save me by Your name, and vindicate me by Your might.
- **PNEUMA:** Come with great power, O God, and rescue me! Defend me with Your might.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
